context: The speaker is a bandit who, with a small crew, has been looting an abandoned chapel and believed they had the place to themselves. The players have quietly infiltrated the same ruin and surprised him, so he reacts with alarm and shouts that they've been spotted. He assumes his companions are nearby and either calls for help or immediately prepares for a fight. The rest of the group is distracted by the loot and arguing among themselves, so their reaction could range from fleeing if intimidated to joining the attack if pressed.
